newsitem.title: ESTONIA: HANSAPANK Q1 NET PROFIT UP 2.6 TIMES.
newsitem.headline: HANSAPANK Q1 NET PROFIT UP 2.6 TIMES.

text.p: Hansapank's first quarter net profit of 96.4 million was up 2.6 times from the same period in 1996, the bank said in its statement on Friday.
Hansapank's market share in Estonia by total assets at the end of February was 25.5 percent.
The bank's efficiency ratios were the following: ROE 51.1 percent, ROA 6.5 percent, net interest margin 5.7 percent.
During the first quarter the bank earned 207.6 million kroons in total revenue, an increase of 92.9 percent over the same period in 1996.
Some 37.1 percent of total revenue was received from net interest income, 39.1 percent from trading income and 23.8 percent from fees and commissions and other income.
The bank's net interest income after provisions grew by 26 percent and non-interest income by 180.8 percent compared to the first quarter results in 1996.
The growth of the latter item was influenced by the sales of 350,000 shares of Hoiupank in January and by trading activities, the bank said.
Hansapank total assets grew by 23.6 percent to 6,852.3 million kroons.
During the period deposits increased by 484.2 million kroons or 14.7 percent.

The net loan portfolio amounted to 3,443 million kroons, which is a growth of 6.9 percent from the start of the year. The allowance for credit losses was 47.8 million kroons or 1.4 percent of the total loan portfolio.
